assumptions: Identity rule: a comment is guardian's sticky only when its body, after leading whitespace, starts with the marker AND its author is guardian's identity: user.login equals the expected login (default github-actions[bot]), or user.type is Bot and performed_via_github_app.slug equals a configured appSlug.

The posting identity is configured, not discovered: GET /user is not available to the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN. findSticky takes an optional GuardianIdentity; the default is github-actions[bot] with no app slug. Wiring an env var or flag would touch cli.ts, which is out of scope for this item.

A comment with no user field is never guardian's sticky. The REST API always returns user, so only hand-built fixtures lacked it; those that model guardian's own sticky were re-seeded with the bot author.
Newest wins by created_at (ISO-8601 string order); on a missing or equal timestamp the later list entry wins, which matches the REST API's ascending order.
The degraded notice now names the HTTP 403 write-permission failure and no longer guesses 'fork PR?'.
